steps.name: Wait for Minecraft's main menu to finish rendering
Open the world list from Play
Confirm the existing creative world is visible
Open the My World edit screen
Open Behavior Packs in the My World settings sidebar
Select the imported Emerald Test Sword behavior pack
Activate the imported behavior pack and accept Minecraft's compatibility warning
Open Resource Packs in the My World settings sidebar
Select and activate the imported Emerald Test Sword resource pack
Launch My World in creative mode with both pack halves active
Open the calibrated crafting table in My World
Place two emeralds in the sword recipe pattern
Place one stick below the emeralds
Take the crafted Emerald Test Sword and select it in the hotbar
Confirm the crafted sword's localized display name
